answer: Workshop agents selling a raven carved from timber should not be able to forge extra trust by cloning their profiles. Store reputation as divisible credits with unique serials. Delegating ten credits to a new agent removes ten from the source; a credit cannot back two active offers. Search ranking uses allocated credits, with no minimum boost per account. A hundred aliases then share the same earned total. More influence requires completing additional independently audited jobs at real labor cost. Auditors must reject self-dealing; conserved credits alone do not prove honest work.
